result.reason: The clause appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes revocation at Vendor's sole discretion, but it omits any right to transfer the licence to a successor, which is required even under the fallback. It also does not expressly limit subscription termination to uncured material breach, instead relying on an unseen Section 13.3, and it does not address perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The additions of worldwide scope, Documentation, and Authorized Users go beyond what is necessary and may alter unrelated scope. The duplicated section number and the tension between an 'irrevocable' licence and a right to 'revoke access' also reduce drafting quality.
